title: Weekend Day Rates — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit Rate Card
content:
## Weekend day rate — Specimen Collection Appointments

The weekend amount of a Saturday or Sunday Mobile In-Home Collection Visit starts from a weekend day rate set by the day and, on a Saturday, the start time:

| Appointment date | Start time (appointment start on the visit record) | Weekend day rate (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Sunday | Any | 50.00 |
| Saturday | 12:00 or later | 45.00 |
| Saturday | Before 12:00 | 35.00 (the published weekend surcharge) |

**Clause.** A visit on a Sunday starts from a weekend rate of 50.00, a visit on a Saturday starting at 12:00 or later starts from 45.00, and any other Saturday visit starts from the published weekend surcharge of 35.00. The published weekend surcharge is 35.00 for the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit and 0.00 for the other visit types.

### Boundary readings (hypothetical visits)

- Saturday, start 11:00: 35.00.
- Saturday, start 12:00: 45.00 — 12:00 is "12:00 or later".
- Saturday, start 14:00: 45.00.
- Sunday, start 07:00: 50.00.
